notes.title: Major Content Update
notes.content:
Behind the scenes, we've been working on a big update that about quadruples the size of the single-player portion of the demo!  We've also greatly reworked the approachability of the single-player mode with infographic training rather than the old forced tutorial.  See the full patch notes below.

We'd love to hear your feedback!  Join us on Discord: https://discord.gg/atm65aC

Single-Player:
11 new rooms built into 3 new levels
+Savable controls and difficulty level in single player
+Highest difficulty a level was completed on is now saved 
+Removed forced tutorial in favor of a slower ramp with infographics to teach new players.

Reworked Explosives for Blue:
+Grenades and rocket damage reduced from 8 to 5
+Grenades and rockets have a slightly different animation, a round hurtbox and faster animation
+Grenades explode on contact with enemies
+Remote bombs animation changed slightly to be more "realistic"
+Remote bomb damage increased from 8 to 10

Miscellaneous:
+Time now has increased weight on the difficulty score
+Added sound effects for opening/closing gates
+Fixed a bug where enemies take damage twice if Red's scratch is hurting them as she touches the ground
+Fixed a rare bug where players could get stuck in gates
+Many other minor changes

Enjoy!

notes.title: Difficulty Options Update (among other things)
notes.content:
We just launched a a pretty big update, the biggest parts of which were 1) now fully functional checkpoints, 2) "Restart" options from the pause menu and game over screen, 3) More options for "Damage Received" on the difficulty level screen

Here's the full list: 

-Checkpoints fully functional
-Added more difficulty options for damage received, up to one-hit deaths
-Re-scaled the difficulty levels.  In general, everything is about 10 points higher and the max difficulty is much higher with the new options (although this will still change with further updates) .
-"Restart Level" and "Restart at Checkpoint" now options in the pause menu
-"Restart Level" now an option on the Game Over Screen

-Clubbot health reduced by 30%.
-Fixed Clubbot walk animation near players.
-Clubbot now has a longer tell.
-Clubbot no longer interrupts attacks by any means (except when destroyed).
-Guards jump outward away from walls when cornered, and bug fixed where they would stay in the standing animation while jumping.

-Fixed a bug where players would jump immediately if the jump button is held and they reach a platform at the peak of a jump.
-When playing 1-2 player, Red now gets her air dash back when Yellow jumps on an enemy.
-Fixed a bug where Red would rarely get stuck if sliding under a narrow passage and at the end of her slide.
-Fixed a bug where enemies would continue to flash well after taking damage.
-Fixed a bug where holding pause to skip the intro scene, then continuing to hold it into the first area would pause as soon as the game began.
-Various other minor tweaks and bug fixes

notes.title: Single-Player Competition now Open
notes.content:
The 4 for the Money Single-Player Competition is now live!  Let the games begin!  A few quick rules to remember:

1. This is a single-player competition!
2. In order for us to consider your performance, you MUST be a 4 for the Money Kickstarter backer.  Go here if you are not a backer yet: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/6180280/4-for-the-money
3. For us to calculate how well you did, you must submit the code provided at the end of the demo, labeled "Competition Code".  This will be submitted by e-mail to compete@lostmarblegames.com with a screenshot or with the code typed in the e-mail.
4. We will determine the winner based on the results we receive.  We reserve the right to require video submissions where we deem fit!

Have fun and give it your all!
A few notes:
1. You can skip the intro scene by holding pause.
2. We would love to see your gameplay videos in the community hub!
3. Contact us at compete@lostmarblegames.com with any questions regarding the competition.

notes.title: First Week of Updates
notes.content:
We've been making quite a few updates over the past week.  These are as follows:

1. Added a tutorial on Assists in the How to Play section.
2. Various issues with text on lower resolutions have been resolved.
3. Improved visuals for the warpback indicator (after you fall down a hole or spend too long offscreen in multiplayer)
4. Added dialogue in 1-1 to encourage new players to read the How to Play section.
5. Fixed a control bug when Redna is player 2 and Windows recognizes the controller in a specific slot.  Ability 1 and Ability 2 would be associated with the same button.
6. Various other minor adjustments in level layouts.

The areas are currently being redesigned for a more specific focus on elements unique to single-player.

Enjoy!
